namespace: Group and Category header data-presence indicator, declared through the shared Control option vocabulary
default: inapplicable on Control; Group and Category indicators are opt-in
effect: none on Control; a containing Group or Category can show a marker for bound descendant data
precedence: a child Control value does not enable its containing Group or Category marker; the containing element's local option overrides config.jsonformsExtended.showDataIndicator
consumer: packages/jsonforms-svelte/src/lib/sectionIndicators.svelte.ts and family Group/Category renderers; no direct Control consumer, matching React groupState.ts
